g.title: power
g.text: Two power domains: the MCU is always on; everything that moves is behind HV_EN

g.title: cluster_mcu
g.text: always-on MCU domain (USB or the pyControl port's 5 V; with only 36 V the board does not boot)

g.title: cluster_sw
g.text: switched domain, alive only while HV_EN is high

g.title: rules
g.text: PowerSequence.hpp is the only code that raises HV_EN.
Up: HV_EN high, wait for +3.3V_SW, then close the bus switch.
Down: open the bus switch, then HV_EN low.
HV_DIAG_EN only while reading HV_SNS or ~HV_FAULT, never idle high.
hv on arms the 100 ms host-loss watchdog: host lost = rail off, FAULTED.
